svg.aria-label: Left: receptive field grows by 2 pixels per 3 by 3 layer with stride 1, but much faster when strides compound. Right: measured influence of each input column on the centre output of a randomly initialised 20-layer stack is a bell-shaped bump far narrower than the theoretical plus or minus 20 pixels
